scope: Q1 visual mapping simulation, 6 objects and 2 layouts, 40 scheduled trials per cell, 480 new trials. No new Astra calls.
preserve_from_finetuned_qwen: per-object frozen backbone, adapter and head
768-dimensional continuous motor goal and unreadable-view fallback
re-query schedule and maximum six model calls
live model latency during physical simulation
copy_from_q1_aimi_within_object: autonomous stop logic including pending-call eligibility and calibrated completion where applicable
matching: Use the Q1 mapping cohort, original target, trial seed, actual reset and original layout transformation. Preserve raw initial images and compare image hashes within layout. Keep archived numerical/reset exceptions explicit; investigate new mismatches.

outcomes.primary: Successful autonomous stop with correct active semantic binding, full quaternion error at most 0.16 rad and no drop
secondary: correct active terminal binding derived from declared target and selected skill

comparison: Within each object-layout cell remove the union of qualifying service exclusions over all four methods from all four denominators. Preserve every scheduled raw outcome. Keep the twelve per-cell results and equal-object original/changed means separate.
inference: Report paired percentage-point differences and two-sided exact McNemar tests for fourth arm vs original fine-tuned and fourth arm vs AIMI; Holm adjustment over all 24 contrasts, reporting raw and adjusted p. With the original fine-tuned arm this estimates the effect of the object-specific control and stopping bundle. The AIMI contrast retains upper-system differences.
engineering_checks: Exclude off-cohort engineering trials. Do not tune parameters on formal outcomes or replace failed episodes. Record timing, code, release and hardware provenance for each run.
